battle.name: 寧江州之戰
battle.brief: 遼天慶四年十一月，完顏阿骨打率女真諸部自拉林河南下，攻克遼在松花江下游的邊州寧江州（今吉林扶餘北伯都納古城）。女真以楯車遮蔽弓弩逼近牆根，擊潰遼援騎，再以穴地與雲梯破城，遼在東北的前線由此崩解，拉開十二年金滅遼之戰。配重投石車未見於本戰紀錄，攻城靠的是近身器械。

kit.name: 配重投石車
kit.history: 長臂配重把石頭甩過城牆。工程比攻城武器更早決定勝負。

countries: 交戰的兩方是契丹帝國與女真部落聯盟，實力對比在開戰時完全失衡。遼國由耶律氏建立，天祚帝耶律延禧在位時已呈崩解之勢：五京分領南北，軍政大權集中於北面樞密院，各州另設節度使領兵，契丹、漢人、渤海遺民各有兵籍與丁口，軍隊編制與裝備並不統一。寧江州（今吉林扶餘北伯都納古城）設寧江軍節度使，治松花江下游沖積平原，是遼在女真故土上的前線要塞，牆垣以木柵與土壘為主，守軍為州兵、契丹騎兵與漢人、渤海戶口編成的城防隊伍，另有自上京方向調來的援軍。女真一方此時尚無國家，以完顏部為核心的諸部聯盟推完顏阿骨打為都勃極烈，行軍編制沿用猛安、孛堇、謀克三級，猛安領千人、孛堇領百人、謀克領十餘人，主力是騎兵，配少量步卒；除完顏本部與數個附屬部落外，又有契丹人阿疏率領的歸附隊伍與逃戶加入。全軍沒有常備後勤，靠漁獵、騎戰掠奪與攻取州城的糧秣維繫，攻城器械與遠程火力幾乎空白。
countriesEn: The two sides were the Khitan Liao empire and an alliance of Jurchen tribes, and the balance of strength was completely lopsided when the fighting began. Liao had been founded by the Yelü house, and under the emperor Tianzong, Yelü Yanxi, it was visibly coming apart: five capitals governed the north and the south, military power was concentrated in the Northern Privy Council, and each prefecture in the borderland kept its own commissioner with troops in hand. Khitans, Chinese and the descendants of the former Bohai kingdom kept separate registers and labour obligations, so the armies were neither uniform in organisation nor uniform in equipment. Ningjiang Prefecture, at the site of Beidunuo near modern Fuyu in Jilin, was the seat of the Ningjiang Army Commissioner, a frontier fortress of Liao standing in the homeland of the Jurchen; its defences were a timber palisade on earthen ramparts, and its garrison was made up of prefectural soldiers, Khitan cavalry and households of Chinese and Bohai origin, with relief troops sent down from the Upper Capital. The Jurchen side had no state yet. An alliance of tribes centred on the Wanyan clan had appointed Wanyan Aguda as dudubolile, and marched in the old Jurchen hierarchy of meng'an, boljin and mok'e, a meng'an leading about a thousand men, a boljin a hundred and a mok'e a little over ten. The core was cavalry with a small number of foot soldiers. Besides the Wanyan clan itself and several dependent tribes, the force was joined by the Khitan defector Ashu and the fugitives he brought. There was no standing logistics train: food, fodder and equipment came from hunting, fishing, plunder on horseback and from whatever the conquered prefectures gave up, and the army had almost no siege equipment and no long-range striking power.
people: 關鍵人物集中在女真一側。完顏阿骨打是完顏部的都勃極烈，出身猛安戶，自幼隨叔父習騎射，目睹遼廷的腐敗與女真丁口被徵、丁口被掠的處境，於遼天慶四年在拉林河畔築城備械，召集諸部起兵，寧江州是他選定的第一個目標；攻城時他以楯車逼近城牆、破遼援騎，再集全力穴地破城，戰後收編降卒與歸附人，使兵力在數月之內成倍擴張。契丹人阿疏自遼境逃出，首倡起兵，被阿骨打倚為謀主，率領歸附的契丹與漢人隨軍作戰，為女真打開遼境內部的接應之路。完顏撒改是阿骨打的從兄，起義核心之一，起兵前曾與阿骨打、吳帶等議定建國方略，寧江州之役後成為金政權的股肱；阿骨打從弟完顏吳帶隨行陣前，於建國前後早逝。遼的天祚帝耶律延禧遠在漠北巡獵，接到寧江州失守的消息時兵尚未集結，隨後的反擊處置失當，先罰後賞、屢易主將，令邊軍益無所守。寧江州的遼方守將姓名與其上層指揮關係，現存記載均不詳，只能確定守軍最終全軍覆沒、州城陷落。
peopleEn: The decisive figures are all on the Jurchen side. Wanyan Aguda, dudubolile of the Wanyan clan, was born into a meng'an household and had ridden and shot from childhood; having watched the rot of the Liao court and seen Jurchen able-bodied men conscripted and Jurchen headmen seized, he built a fortified town on the Lalin River in the fourth year of Liao's Tianqing era, stored arms there and called the tribes to arms, choosing Ningjiang Prefecture as his first objective. He brought his shield carts up against the wall, broke the Liao relief cavalry, then concentrated his strength on the mine tunnels and the final assault, and afterwards absorbed surrendered soldiers and defectors, multiplying the size of his army within a few months. Ashu, a Khitan who had fled the Liao realm, was the first to call for the rising, was trusted by Aguda as chief strategist, and led the Khitan and Chinese deserters who fought in Aguda's ranks, opening a seam inside Liao territory. Wanyan Sagamai, Aguda's clan brother, was one of the core conspirators; before the rising he and Aguda and Wudai worked out the plan for founding a state, and after the campaign at Ningjiang he became a pillar of the Jin regime. Aguda's younger clan brother Wanyan Wudai served in the field and died young around the founding. Liao's Tianzong Yelü Yanxi was away hunting in the northern steppe when the news of Ningjiang's fall reached him, his army not yet assembled; his reaction was badly mismanaged, punishing and promoting commanders in the wrong order, so that the border troops no longer knew whom to obey. The name of the Liao commander at Ningjiang and the shape of his chain of command are not recorded in the surviving sources; all that can be established is that the garrison was wiped out and the prefectural city fell.
kits: 本戰的攻城技術核心不是配重投石車，這件兵器在此戰的紀錄裡沒有出現。配重投石車屬於西亞與中亞的攻城技術，經唐代傳入中原，十二世紀初已在宋與金的邊城攻防中成為常見的遠程重裝備，原理是以長臂末端的配重箱提供拋射能量，把石彈越過城頭砸向城內，射程遠、破壞力大，但造價與工期都高。寧江州是松花江下游的木柵邊城，女真人只帶了楯車、穴地工具與雲梯而至：楯車以牛馬牽引，車上堆置盾牌與枯草作遮蔽，弓手藏身車後發矢，遼的城頭弓弩因此難以施展；穴地則是掘地道抵近牆根，撐木以免土壁崩塌，再以雲梯附城攀緣。守方的器械則以城頭弓弩、拒馬、雉堞與投石為主，契丹騎兵倚賴重甲與長弓。裝備兩端差距很大：女真缺攻城重器，遼卻缺能及時開援的邊兵。真正主導此役的，是楯車這種就地取材、當場可造的遮蔽器械，以及隨後把配重投石車的技術線補上的那條路——十二世紀中葉金軍進攻遼之上京、燕雲十六州與其後南下攻宋時，才系統配備撞車、飛石、雲梯與配重投石車，攻城能力成為金軍取勝的關鍵。
kitsEn: The siege engineering at the centre of this campaign was not the counterweight trebuchet; the weapon does not appear in any record of the battle. A counterweight trebuchet belongs to the West Asian and Central Asian siege tradition, reached China during the Tang, and by the early twelfth century had become a standard heavy piece of ordnance in the border warfare of both Song and Jin: the weight box at the end of the long arm supplies the energy, hurling a stone over the parapet to fall inside the wall, with long range and heavy destructive effect but high cost and long build time. Ningjiang was a timber-palised frontier town on the lower Songhua, and the Jurchen came with shield carts, tools for mining and scaling ladders. The shield carts were drawn by oxen and horses, loaded with shields and brushwood as cover, with archers hidden behind them shooting through the gaps, which deprived the Liao archers and crossbowmen on the wall of their effect. Mining meant driving a tunnel under the wall root, propping the earth with timber so it would not collapse, and then bringing up ladders. The defenders relied on bows and crossbows on the wall, cheval-de-frise, parapets and stones thrown by hand, and the Khitan cavalry trusted heavy armour and the long bow. The gap in equipment between the two sides was wide: the Jurchen lacked heavy siege machines, Liao lacked border troops who could bring relief in time. What actually decided the campaign was the shield cart, a cover device that could be built from local materials on the spot, and the line of development that later supplied the trebuchet: only in the mid-twelfth century, when the Jin army attacked Liao's Upper Capital and the Sixteen Prefectures and then turned south against Song, did it systematically field battering rams, stone-throwers, scaling ladders and counterweight trebuchets, and siege capability became the key to Jin's victories.
tactics: 女真的戰法可以分成四段。蓄勢：起兵前在拉林河畔築城，屯馬備械，積存箭矢與乾糧，等到冬季河道封凍、遼邊無糧草顧慮之際才出兵。疾進：全軍以騎兵為主，不走大路，不打會戰，直撲最近的邊州；由拉林河到寧江州直線約一百八十公里，數日即抵城下，遼的斥候與烽燧還沒把消息送遍全境。攻城：以楯車結陣前進，車上盾牌與枯草構成活動掩體，弓手自車縫射擊，遼的床弩與弓箭多落空；遼騎兵反覆衝擊車陣，女真步卒下車以矛斧近身纏鬥，並刺人馬，趁亂把車推抵牆根。殲援：女真分出一部在城外迎擊自上京方向趕到的遼援騎，趁其遠來疲憊而擊潰，然後合兵圍城，以穴地掘進牆下、以雲梯同時登數處城頭，士氣已崩的守軍很快被突破。奪城：破城之後不急於細搜，先控制城門、封存軍器庫與糧倉，再散粟撫集降戶，把整座邊州變成下一步的基地。遼方的反制則因指揮脫節而失效：邊軍單薄、天祚帝出獵在外、援軍集結遲滯、契丹貴族互相推諉，使每一次馳援都落在女真預設的時間與地點上。
tacticsEn: The Jurchen method falls into four stages. Preparation: before the rising they built a town on the Lalin River, stabled horses and stored arms, laid up arrows and dried grain, and waited for winter, when the frozen rivers and the absence of fodder trouble in the Liao borderland made campaigning cheapest. March: the army was almost entirely mounted, avoided the main roads, fought no pitched battle, and drove straight at the nearest frontier prefecture; from the Lalin River to Ningjiang Prefecture is roughly 180 kilometres in a straight line, and the horsemen were at the walls within days, before Liao's scouts and beacon stations had carried the news across the frontier. Siege: the shield carts advanced in formation, shields and brushwood on the wagons forming a mobile cover from which archers shot, while the Liao crossbows and bows largely went over the carts or struck the brushwood; Liao cavalry charged the wagon line again and again, the Jurchen foot dismounted to fight at close quarters with spear and axe, wounding horses and shoving the carts up to the wall when the line broke. Destroying the relief: a detachment met the Liao horse that came down from the Upper Capital outside the walls, catching it tired from the march and breaking it, and then the whole force closed on the city, mining under the wall and putting ladders up at several points of the rampart at once, the shaken defenders giving way quickly. Seizure: once inside, the priority was not a thorough sweep but the gates, the armoury and the granaries, after which grain was distributed to the population and the whole prefecture became the base for the next step. Liao's countermoves failed through a broken chain of command: thin border troops, the emperor away on the hunt, relief armies slow to gather, and aristocratic Khitans shifting blame one for another, so that every relieving column arrived exactly where and when the Jurchen had arranged to meet it.
data: 可核的數字不多，湊得出來的只有這些。時間：遼天慶四年，即 1114 年，起兵在年內秋末冬初，寧江州之戰在十一月；其後 1115 年正月攻黃龍府，同月建金，金滅遼之戰自 1114 年至 1125 年歷十二年。地理：拉林河在今黑龍江省哈爾濱市阿城區一帶，寧江州在今吉林省扶餘市，遺址為北伯都納古城，兩地直線相距約一百八十公里；州城建於松花江下游沖積平原，牆垣以木柵與土壘為主。編制：女真行軍分猛安、孛堇、謀克三級；遼的邊軍由州兵與北面調來的軍馬組成，寧江州設節度使。兵力：女真初起兵時的實際人數，記載互有出入，說法從數千到數萬都有，均不足為憑；遼援軍的規模與城內守軍人數同樣無數可據。可靠的一個量化紀錄是金史所載金國初建時「鄰境七十三部皆降」，可見勢力擴張之速。攻城耗費：楯車每輛須牛馬牽引、需數人操作，穴地與雲梯皆需人手與木材，城破後所得的糧秣與軍器，是女真人過冬與擴軍的物質基礎。
dataEn: Verifiable figures are scarce, and only a few can be set down. Date: the fourth year of Liao's Tianqing era, 1114; the rising began in the late autumn and early winter of that year, the battle for Ningjiang fell in the eleventh month; in the first month of 1115 Huanglong Prefecture was taken and Jin was proclaimed in the same month, and the war that destroyed Liao ran from 1114 to 1125, twelve years. Geography: the Lalin River lies in the Acheng district of modern Harbin, Heilongjiang; Ningjiang Prefecture lay at modern Fuyu in Jilin, at the site of the Beidunuo walled town, and the two lie roughly 180 kilometres apart in a straight line. The prefectural town stood on the alluvial plain of the lower Songhua, its defences timber and earth. Organisation: the Jurchen marched in three degrees, meng'an, boljin and mok'e; the Liao border force was made of prefectural troops and horses sent out from the northern administration, and Ningjiang had its own army commissioner. Numbers: the actual size of the Jurchen army when it rose is given inconsistently, ranging in the accounts from a few thousand to tens of thousands, none of which can be treated as settled; the scale of the Liao relief force and the number of the garrison inside the walls are equally unrecorded. One reliable quantified statement survives, that when Jin was first founded the seventy-three neighbouring tribes all submitted, which shows how fast the movement spread. Costs of the assault: every shield cart needed draught animals and several men, mining and scaling ladders both needed hands and timber, and the grain, arms and equipment taken from the city after it fell were the material base that carried the Jurchen through the winter and paid for the expansion of the army.
cause: 起兵的緣由有遠因也有近因。遠因是遼廷的敗壞：耶律延禧沉溺游獵，拒諫飾非，把勢力推向自己的兄弟與權貴，女真丁口被強行括入軍籍、部落首長被誣告下獄，遼使與軍將不斷到女真地界索人、括戶，怨氣積到鄰境各部。至 1114 年，完顏阿骨打遣使赴遼，要求歸還逃入女真地界的叛戶與舊屬，遼不答，反而催促各部照舊供賦、供兵，交涉破裂，阿骨打遂以拒絕再受驅使者號召諸部，在拉林河畔築城、備械、練兵。近因還有天祚帝本人：巡獵在外，京師與邊鎮的調兵機關空轉，寧江州一帶的守備只剩常駐州兵與有限的巡邏騎兵，邊防空虛到女真騎兵已抵城下仍無援兵情報的程度。於是一場原本可能以朝貢與人口交涉收場的邊境衝突，被阿骨打變成公開反叛，金與遼的戰爭由寧江州打開序幕。
causeEn: The coming to blows had both distant and immediate causes. The distant cause was the rottenness of the Liao court: Yelü Yanxi gave himself to hunting, rejected remonstrance, covered faults with decoration, and drove the real power into his own brothers and his favourites, while Jurchen households were repeatedly registered for service, tribal headmen were arrested on accusation, and Liao envoys and officers kept crossing into Jurchen country to seize men and count households, so that resentment built up along the border. By 1114 Wanyan Aguda had sent envoys to Liao demanding the return of those who had fled into Jurchen territory and belonged to their old clans; Liao gave no answer and instead pressed the tribes to keep up their tribute and their levies, and the negotiation broke down, so Aguda called the tribes together on the pretext of refusing to be driven again, and built a town, stored arms and drilled on the Lalin River. The immediate cause was the emperor himself: away on the hunt, the machinery at court and in the frontier towns stood idle, and the defence of Ningjiang was reduced to the prefectural garrison and a few patrolling horsemen, so empty that the Jurchen horse were already under the walls before word of them reached the capital. What might have been settled as a quarrel over tribute and population was thus turned by Aguda into open revolt, and the war between Jin and Liao opened at Ningjiang.
impact: 寧江州陷落的直接後果，是遼在東北的邊防體系整體崩解。此後女真連續攻取黃龍府、興州、廬州等東北重鎮，把松花江與遼河流域盡數納入版圖；金國在遷都之前已能以松花江流域為基地修造城寨、編練大軍。1115 年正月完顏阿骨打稱帝建金，形成與宋、遼鼎足的新力量，南北格局隨之改變。技術層面的影響更值得留意：女真初起兵時能用的攻城手段只有楯車與穴地，靠速度與突然性吃掉了木柵邊城，卻沒有能力攻擊燕雲一線的堅城；1120 年攻遼之上京、1122 年前後取中京與南京時，金軍才把撞車、飛石、雲梯乃至配重投石車這一整套遠程攻城技術系統化，攻城能力成為金滅遼的關鍵手段，而這套技術後來隨金軍南下，轉而在北宋身上重演。寧江州因此不只是金國的建國前哨，也是一個技術斷點：此時女真靠的是騎兵與近身器械，往後讓金軍在中原城下屢屢奏效的，才是配重投石車那一類以工程力換取攻城效率的器械。
impactEn: The fall of Ningjiang Prefecture had an immediate consequence: the whole Liao defence system in the north-east came apart. The Jurchen, soon to be called Jin, took Huanglong, Xingzhou and Luzhou in succession and absorbed the Songhua and Liao river basins, and before any move of the capital they could already build towns and drill a great army on the Songhua. In the first month of 1115 Wanyan Aguda proclaimed himself emperor and founded Jin, creating a new power alongside Song and Liao and altering the balance of the realm. The technological consequences are worth more attention. At the outset the Jurchen had only the shield cart and the mine to their name, and took timber-walled frontier towns by speed and surprise; they had no capacity to attack the solid cities of the Sixteen Prefectures. Only in 1120 at the Upper Capital of Liao, and around 1122 at the Central and Southern Capitals, did the Jin army systematise the whole range of distant siege technique, battering rams, stone throwers, scaling ladders and counterweight trebuchets, and siege capability became the key to the destruction of Liao. That technology later travelled south with the Jin armies and was turned on the Song in turn. Ningjiang is therefore not merely a birth-post of the Jin state but a technological turning point: at that moment the Jurchen relied on cavalry and close combat, and what afterwards worked again and again before the cities of the central plain was the counterweight trebuchet, engineering force bought at the price of siege efficiency.
result: 寧江州之戰以女真完勝告終：州城陷落，遼在松花江下游的前線要塞與整條邊防同時崩解，女真一方取得城垣、軍器、糧秣與一批降卒與歸附戶，起義的勢能由此轉成國家的規模。遼的反應遲緩而失序，天祚帝倉促處置，先後貶黜、誅罰與換將，邊軍無所適從；其後 1115 年正月黃龍府亦告失守，遼的東北門戶洞開，江北之地盡失。對這件兵器而言，本役留下一個清楚的界線：配重投石車並未出現在寧江州城下，決定勝負的是楯車遮蔽弓弩的陣形、穴地與雲梯的近身工程，以及速戰速決的節奏；遠程重裝備要到金軍具備製造、供應與操縱它的完整體系之後才會上戰場，此後才在燕雲與中原的攻城中扮演主角。從一場邊州之役到十二年滅遼、再到十三年後的靖康之變，這條線上的第一個缺口正是在此時埋下。
resultEn: The campaign ended in a clear Jurchen victory: the prefectural city fell, Liao's frontier fortress on the lower Songhua and the whole border line broke down together, and the Jurchen gained walls, arms, grain, a batch of surrendered soldiers and defectors, so that the momentum of the rising turned into the scale of a state. Liao's response was late and disordered; Tianzong hastily dealt with the disaster, demoting, punishing and replacing commanders in turn, and the border troops no longer knew whom to follow, and in the first month of 1115 Huanglong Prefecture was lost as well, leaving Liao's north-eastern gate wide open and the country north of the river gone. For the weapon on the card, this campaign leaves a clean boundary: the counterweight trebuchet did not stand before Ningjiang, and what decided the day was the formation that shielded the bows with shield carts, the close engineering of tunnels and ladders, and the tempo of a fast campaign. Heavy ranged equipment reached the battlefield only once the Jin had the organisation to build, supply and crew it, and only then did it take the leading part in the sieges of the Sixteen Prefectures and of the central plain. From a battle for a frontier prefecture to twelve years of war that destroyed Liao, and on to the Jingkang disaster thirteen years later, the first gap in that line was dug here.
